skill.name: recall
skill.description: Deeply retrieve Context Nest vault context for a topic and answer with citations. Use when you need the full graph of related vault knowledge beyond what auto-retrieval injected.
skill.summary: Retrieve related Context Nest vault documents and answer topic questions with source citations.
skill.author: promptowl

content.user_title: Retrieve Vault Knowledge With Source Citations
content.value_statement: Automatic context retrieval can miss related knowledge stored across vault documents. Recall guides deeper Context Nest searches and graph queries to produce answers with source citations.
actual_capabilities: List available vaults, validate pinned aliases, and select vaults by topic descriptions.
Search for seed nodes and map their identifiers to tags.
Build tag selectors with union, intersection, and exclusion operators.
Retrieve documents and related nodes using graph queries with three hops.
Read individual nodes or widen selectors when initial results are thin.
Summarize findings with vault:id citations and a final list of used node identifiers.
limitations: Requires the ctx CLI, Bash access, and accessible Context Nest vaults.
Retrieval depends on existing vault documents, tags, descriptions, and graph relationships.
Does not modify vault content or create missing knowledge.
Provides retrieval instructions, not an implementation or security audit of the ctx CLI.

use_cases.title: Recover Technical Decisions
use_cases.description: Retrieve architecture notes and related decisions to answer implementation questions with source references.

use_cases.title: Connect Research Notes
use_cases.description: Follow related vault nodes to summarize a research topic beyond the initial search results.

use_cases.title: Review Product Context
use_cases.description: Find linked planning documents and summarize recorded requirements with traceable citations.

prompt_templates.title: Recall a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Recall what my Context Nest vault says about [topic]. Cite each point and list the node identifiers used.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Specific Vault
prompt_templates.prompt: Recall [topic] from vault [alias]. Validate the alias first, then summarize the relevant documents with citations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Recall decisions about [topic A] and [topic B]. Compare the recorded rationale using related nodes and cite each supported claim.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Sparse Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [topic] in the relevant vaults. Build tag selectors, query three hops, and widen sparse results or read individual nodes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: explore a broader document graph.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Recall the deployment decision from the engineering vault.
output: Illustrative answer: The deployment note records a staged rollout to limit release exposure (engineering:deploy-note).
A related review records monitoring requirements before broader rollout (engineering:release-review).

output_examples.input: Recall what the selected vault says about lunar shipping schedules.
output: The selected vault has no information about lunar shipping schedules.

best_practices: Use specific topic terms and verify the selected vault matches your intended scope.
Keep vault:id citations attached to supported claims and review the referenced nodes.
Widen selectors when results are thin, while preserving the read-only boundary.
anti_patterns: Treating missing retrieval results as proof that information does not exist elsewhere.
Using recall to edit, delete, or create vault documents.
Presenting unsupported conclusions as facts recorded in the vault.

faq.question: What must be available before using Recall?
faq.answer: The ctx CLI, Bash access, and accessible Context Nest vaults must already be available.

faq.question: How does Recall choose a vault?
faq.answer: It lists vaults, validates a pinned alias, and otherwise selects vaults whose descriptions match the topic.

faq.question: How does it retrieve related documents?
faq.answer: It searches for seed nodes, maps identifiers to tags, and queries tag selectors with three graph hops.

faq.question: Can Recall change my vault?
faq.answer: The skill explicitly requires read-only retrieval and prohibits modifying the vault.

faq.question: How are answers attributed?
faq.answer: Each point uses a vault:id citation, and the answer ends with a list of node identifiers used.

faq.question: What happens when the vault has no relevant information?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to state directly that the vault has nothing on the topic.
